text: Lanternwake Harbor, one more fix: on my phone in the day look, each message's name and time sit outside the bubble right on the harbor art and are hard to read. Make them readable in day and night without adding rows (a plate behind them or a shadow, your call). Look at the day background again first so you know what they sit on.

Rainy Café: the Home picture you picked only shows as a thin cropped strip at the bottom of the small What's new card. Put it somewhere it actually shows on Home (check your theme-design handbook for what Home can hold), and keep the What's new card tidy.

My blue Velvet Casket copy: at night it's properly blue, but in the day look the bubbles, top bar and sidebar are still lavender and pink, only the pictures turned blue. Make the day palette blue too (pale blues instead of lavender/pink), keeping its coffin shapes and art.
